About me

Hello, I'm Phil. I've been a web designer and developer for many, many years. But since being made redundant in October 2026, I wanted to branch out on my own and start a business which involves some passions as well as the career I'm experienced in.

Treading the boards

My first passion was theatre - my first degree was Theatre Studies and I was never off the boards from about 13 - 21 years old.

Musical switch

I'd been a songwriter throughout this time. While at university I wrote musicals (!) & performed solo. Then I got a band together - actually strictly various bands all with me and a mate, a drummer, at their core. That was when I really got interested in writing and performing music.

These days, [mumbles] years on I'm more interested in writing and production (and making films to go along with the music).
